purpose: Mark that a former situation has already ceased to apply.
keywords: We can no longer postpone it.
This is no longer a quiet village.
By now, everyone knows his name.
mistake: It is stronger than simply もう in casual timing statements.

segments.role: Mark that a former situation has already ceased to apply. もはや + changed state / negative
